src/sqllens/rule_sets.py: _deeper (637-648) raises when _depth >= MAX_EXISTS_DEPTH (16), so at most 16 nested levels. _new_slot (624-634) raises when _slots >= MAX_SLOTS (64), so at most 64 slots. compile() (657) allocates slot 0 for the filtered table. _node wraps _deeper around OwnerViaRule (694), InheritRule (707), direct ReferencedByRule (719), each one level. External doc docs/external/rule-sets.md:197 states the join-pair type rule: both integer or both string families, with the type lists, and any other type joins only the exact same type (decimal with decimal, not bigint).
